releaseNotes:
v6.8.0 — The Ultimate Modern Experience

🎤 All-New Lyrics Experience:
• Multi-Source Aggregator: Real-time synchronized lyrics from Musixmatch, Genius, LrcLib, and NewPipe caption fallbacks.
• Karaoke Word Glow: Live word-by-word synchronized highlighting and fluid scrolling.
• Smart Romanization: Instant transliteration for Hindi/Urdu (Hinglish) and Bengali into Roman script.
• Neural Translation: On-the-fly translation powered by Google Neural translation.

🤖 Gemini AI Music Suite (BYOK):
• AI Song Finder: Identify tracks by humming, singing, partial lyrics, or misheard lines.
• Visual Album Recognition: Snap or upload album artwork, vinyl covers, and setlists.
• Web-Grounded Verification: Live Google Search grounding to accurately confirm songs and artist info.

🎙️ Voice Search:
• Hands-free music discovery with real-time audio waveform animations and graceful microphone permission guidance.

☁️ Google Sign-In & Cloud Sync:
• Sign in with Google to backup and sync your playlists, liked songs, and listening history directly to your private Google Drive app storage across all your devices.

🔄 Seamless In-App Updates:
• Check for new releases, view complete changelogs, download updates in the background with live progress indicators, and install with 1 tap.

🔐 Privacy, Permissions & Performance:
• Enhanced Onboarding: Playback notification permission gate ensures uninterrupted lock-screen audio controls on Android 13+.
• Permissions Manager: Dedicated settings panel to manage and inspect all app permissions.
• Performance & Stability: Uncompromised full-stack runtime with all reflection, serialization, and media components preserved.
• Strict Security: Enforced strict HTTPS, eliminated plaintext traffic, and consolidated NewPipe Extractor v0.26.5.
